post.description: Processes stateless MCP requests. Request and response bodies are opaque JSON objects because their exact JSON-RPC shape depends on the MCP method.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: MCP protocol version; required and matched against request metadata for modern requests

parameters.name: Mcp-Method
parameters.description: MCP method; required and matched against the JSON-RPC body for modern requests

parameters.name: Mcp-Name
parameters.description: MCP tool name; required and matched for modern tools/call requests

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Request origin, when sent, must be allow-listed

requestBody.description: Opaque MCP JSON-RPC request object; fields depend on the requested method

400.description: Invalid MCP metadata, protocol version, or malformed JSON body

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired read API key

403.description: Request origin is not allowed

404.description: Unknown modern MCP method

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit

500.description: MCP authentication or request processing failed

verified.description:
Always true: stored hints are verified against `computed_at_sha`.
Retained for chunk-3/publication and generated-client compatibility.

changed.description:
True when this call recorded the standing decision; false when a prior
decision already stood and was returned unchanged.

decidedAt.description:
When the standing decision was made. Matches the request time when this
call recorded the decision, and the original decision time when a prior
decision stands.

DashboardFeedbackFacets.description:
Facet counts across the complete retained search/time window.

Counts use disjunctive faceting: each facet honors every active filter
except its own selection, so alternative values remain discoverable within
the filtered context. Pagination is never applied to these aggregates.

DashboardFeedbackPage.description:
A bounded, server-filtered page of feedback reports.

`total` is computed from the complete retained product dataset with the
active filters, not from the returned page.

DashboardSessionResponse.description:
A canonical Epode enrichment question associated with one session interaction.

This read model contains only the bounded, normalized answer items accepted by
Epode. It deliberately does not expose an agent prompt, tool input, or query.

DashboardSessionSummary.description:
A session row enriched with complete server-side rollups for the dashboard.

Dashboard interaction and report windows are independently paginated. Keeping
these counts on the session summary prevents an older session from appearing
empty merely because its interactions are outside the currently loaded window.

DashboardSessionsPage.description:
A bounded, server-filtered page of proven sessions.

The rollup is computed across every retained session matching the active
filters, independently of the current page.

config.description: Normalized non-secret configuration. Credentials are never returned.

syncing.description: True while a worker holds the sync claim.

connectionUrl.description:
`postgres`: connection URL without an embedded password, e.g.
`postgres://user@host:5432/dbname?sslmode=require`.

headers.description:
`http_ndjson`: extra request headers. Non-sensitive only: values are
stored in plaintext configuration, not in the sealed credential store.

schema.description: `postgres`: schema that receives the export tables; defaults to `public`.

url.description: `http_ndjson`: collector URL that accepts NDJSON POST batches.

password.description: `postgres`: database password (the URL never carries one).

FeedbackFinding.description:
Schema-only view of legacy JSONB findings. Known fields are optional and
additional properties remain allowed because stored output is passed through.

FeedbackWorkaround.description:
Schema-only view of legacy JSONB workarounds. Known fields are optional and
additional properties remain allowed because stored output is passed through.

accountLogin.description: Login of the GitHub user or organization that owns the installation.

createdAt.description: Time when the installation was first connected to the workspace.

id.description: Internal identifier for the stored installation record.

configured.description: Whether the server has complete GitHub App configuration.

installations.description: Active GitHub App installations connected to the workspace.

installationId.description: GitHub installation whose repositories were listed.

repositories.description: Repositories currently accessible to the installation.

truncated.description:
True when the pagination cap cut the listing short, so `repositories` is
a partial view of the installation rather than the complete set.

private.description: Whether GitHub marks the repository as private.

OpaqueJsonObject.description: Opaque JSON object whose fields depend on the MCP JSON-RPC method.
